Frequently Asked Questions

How much does solar cost?

Cost depends on your usage, but government subsidies reduce it significantly. Most systems pay for themselves in 5-6 years.

How long does installation take?

Installation typically takes 3-5 business days after site approval. We handle all paperwork for you.

What warranty do you offer?

We provide 25-year performance warranty on all solar panels and 5-year warranty on installation work.
